about: The introitus of the formulary “Holy Thursday — Mass of the Lord's Supper” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: But it behooveth us to glory in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in Whom is our salvation, life, and resurrection; by Whom we have been saved and delivered. May God have mercy on us and bless us; may He cause the light of His countenance to shine upon us and have mercy on us. But it behooveth us to glory in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in Whom is our salvation, life, and resurrection; by Whom we have been saved and delivered.
